tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: The kinds of work people track time on, e.g. Design or Meetings. You choose which tasks each project uses.
tasks.deleteBody: The task is removed. A record of it stays in the account's audit log. A task that is used on projects can't be deleted; archive it instead.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.body: Create the tasks your team works on, then add them to projects.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: e.g. Design, Development or Project management.
fields.isDefaultHint: New projects start with this task selected. You can still remove it from a project.
fields.defaultBillableHint: Time on this task counts as billable unless a project says otherwise.
fields.defaultRateHint: Used on projects billed by task. Leave empty for no rate.
